scope.raw_palette: all 315 CDS raw palette names: 9 families × 35 shades
scope.semantic_profiles: CDS explicit light/dark; legacy v1 and v2 light/dark; HSL bridge
scope.declaration_inventory: All definitions for color-taxonomy names, except --text-body (font-size), plus 26 explicitly identified component color names. Other utility tokens, shadows, dimensions, third-party themes and inline colors are not claimed exhaustive.
scope.profile_meaning: Named declaration selections from one packaged source. No cross-file merge, DOM activation, full cascade simulation, system-mode selection or feature-query activation is asserted.
scope.alpha: Uncomposited channel alpha. HEX is rounded 8-bit sRGB display; exact original declaration and floating sRGB channels are retained. HSL component triples represent colors only when consumed as hsl(...).

note: Compact reusable value export. Full derivation is reproducible with the catalog builder; the interactive catalog includes searchable values.

resolution_extension.scope: Additive derivation under original named static profiles. Original declarations, statuses, and statistics remain unchanged. Extended sRGB is not clipped to HEX. Contextual values need their consumer.

browser_css_semantics.limitation: Isolated original fixture verifies CSS semantics, not logged-in product appearance or the integrated catalog UI.
